evidence_census.scope: This Surface generation makes only tracked-source claims; authenticated acceptance remains audit evidence rather than a Surface input.

evidence_sources.observation: The store implements an append-only change ledger, content-addressed graph state, immutable manifests, leases, workflow state, slices, and exact database reconstruction.
The supervisor executes sealed invocations through qualified, isolated subscription CLIs and persists versioned runtime receipts, artifacts, cancellation, and terminal failure state.
The importer and workflow runtime bind exact Octopus sources, governed context modules, external authoritative blackboards, deterministic transitions, and read-only Platform Foundry inspection.
The cockpit supports preflight, exact compiled-context inspection, arbitrary multi-parent routing, sanitized response rendering, runtime/artifact inspection, and governed workflow state.
Truth-typed tests exercise independent reconstruction, append-only rebuild, lease and workflow idempotency, authority boundaries, cross-workflow semantics, and deliberately false mutations.
The canonical workframe contract states Loom's telos, boundaries, current acceptance, and known incomplete German workflow.
Workflow tests independently exercise authoritative reads, rejected mutation authority, exact query freezing, command idempotency, restart ambiguity, required context, and Platform Foundry reuse.

claims.summary: Loom persists an append-only invocation lattice whose current database, joins, context, and lineage can be reconstructed exactly from the ledger and content-addressed blobs.
Claude and Codex execution is isolated, leased, journaled, cancellable, restart-aware, artifact-preserving, and bound to observable CLI/runtime identity with explicit provider proof limits.

Octopus import, governed context modules, executable quaternary transitions, Slate/Axial projections, and read-only Platform Foundry reuse work; German native-role qualification remains externally blocked.

The response-first cockpit operates arbitrary Claude/Codex routing, forks and joins, exact preflight and retrospective context inspection, sanitized responses, artifacts, attempts, local graph views, and workflow blackboards.
Truth-typed tests, clean source and wheel builds, mutation controls, and a complete initial audit-remediation ledger exist; the new frozen-revision closure audit remains to be issued.
